Name: Return Scepter Confirmation
Author: BNutJ
Description:
[b][size=5]Ever accidentally use your return scepter?  Help is here!

[/size][size=4][u]Return Scepter Confirmation

[/u][/size][/b][size=3][b]This mod aims to prevent accidental usage in two ways!
[/b]
[/size][list=1]
[*]After activating the return scepter, the user is prompted with a Yes/No dialog asking if they want to return to their farm.
[*]After confirming the warp, the selected hotbar position is changed to slot #1.  This prevents an accidental usage after warping.
[/list]
This mod assumes the user will [b][u]not[/u] [/b]have the return scepter in slot #1.


Mod has been tested on single-player and local multi-player split screen!


[i]Note: There are some references to "MK" throughout the package -- that is I.  I am the uploader and creator.[/i]

Manifest.Name: Return Scepter Confirmation
Manifest.Description: Prompts the player for confirmation before using the Return Scepter. Supports split-screen multiplayer.
Manifest.Author: J_MK
